payload.reason: The evidence provides specific improvements in F1 scores for speculation detection and scope resolution tasks, indicating previously reported results and comparisons with existing models.

claims.text: Substantial improvements were reported over previously reported results, with at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
XLNet consistently outperformed BERT and RoBERTa in speculation detection and scope resolution tasks, contrary to results on other benchmark datasets.
The paper reported state-of-the-art results on negation scope resolution for the BioScope Corpus and SFU Review Corpus, with specific F1 point increases.
Training on multiple datasets yielded significant gains over single dataset training, with improvements of up to 10.6 F1 points on speculation detection.
